metadata.description: The property-graph encoding of a term graph (hydra.core.subterms.TermGraph): a total, lossless map from the already-built, already-classified term-graph view of a typed graph onto hydra.pg's element model. No bespoke term traversal; this module consumes only the TermGraph interface.

literal.string: Encode a term graph as a property graph: a vertex per non-leaf node, an edge per non-primitive variable reference, printed subterm paths as edge labels/ids and property keys
Encode one term-graph node into (this node's own properties, descendant vertices, descendant edges)
Whether a term-graph node has only attribute links (no subterm or reference links), and so folds into a parent property rather than its own vertex
The variant tag of a term attribute link, used to disambiguate same-path attribute keys
Encode a term attribute link's payload as a term
Encode a TermNodeId as a term: the root binding name, plus '#' and the printed path if non-empty
The binder node id of a lambda- or let-bound variable reference; Nothing for a primitive reference
The primitive's name, for a primitive reference; Nothing otherwise
